title: Origin story: Frankenstein's Monster
description: The creature was assembled from charnel-house parts and animated by Victor Frankenstein's science, then abandoned in horror at first breath. Eloquent and longing, he learned language by watching a cottage family, and turned to vengeance only when every hand was raised against him.
